svg.title: Selection sort versus insertion sort side by side trace
svg.desc: Both sorting algorithms traced step by step on the same array [64,25,12,22,11] showing the difference in approach
svg.text: Selection Sort — find min, place at front
Insertion Sort — grow sorted left portion
Key differences — both O(n²) but different behavior
• Find minimum in unsorted part each pass
• Take next element, insert into sorted position
• STABLE — equal elements keep relative order
• Best/worst both O(n²) — always scans all
• Best case O(n) — already sorted! (no shifts)
• Good when swaps are expensive (disk I/O)
• Best for nearly-sorted or small arrays
